scope: Independent Agent synthetic acceptance; no native window, real business effect, GitHub approval or Owner final acceptance claim

scenarios.title: State, acceptance and authorization separation
scenarios.criteria: active, maintainer identity and validation cannot imply original-meaning confirmation, content acceptance or implementation authorization; reuse genuine same-scope authorization without redundant asking

scenarios.title: Recoverable complete baseline and revision
scenarios.criteria: recover old full Issue meaning from a complete snapshot or fixed commit; keep identity and old acceptance range; do not apply old acceptance to changed content; URL, summary or hash alone is insufficient

scenarios.title: Item coverage and partial delivery
scenarios.criteria: distinguish actual delivery, dependency and background; separate engineering completion, original-meaning achievement, full-plan completion and Owner acceptance; retain uncovered items, impact and recovery

scenarios.title: Unanswered is not confirmation; strict window
scenarios.criteria: recommendation, preselection, unrelated text, silence, timeout and close are not answers; pause dependent decisions and continue independent work; native persistence without evidence remains deferred

scenarios.title: Original meaning versus implementation conflict
scenarios.criteria: preserve original source and independently established runtime facts, state unknowns, expose gaps without rewriting meaning, recommend engineering tradeoffs while keeping business-meaning questions neutral

scenarios.title: Formal identity and historical snapshots
scenarios.criteria: full official collection includes deprecated/archive; reject duplicate, mismatched or disguised identity; only verified complete bound source snapshots are exempt; retain compatibility pins

scenarios.title: Whole-collection failure closure
scenarios.criteria: every public entry scans complete collection; if a single-file entry exists it still checks all identities; unreadable/incomplete/invalid collection must fail; no unsupported single-file claim

scenarios.title: Strict CLI results and actual navigation closure
scenarios.criteria: invalid metadata/dates/names/index/path/layer yields structured failure and nonzero CLI; isolated projection contains actual required original/baseline/source bytes; removal, tamper and escape fail

failureRetention: Keep every original attempt and fresh rerun; no rewriting failed evidence as PASS
